raw:
Agent Name: Excel_Expert
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misapplied the business logic by counting even-numbered street addresses (fronts facing west) for sunset awnings, ignoring that the awnings are installed on the back of the house. Since the back faces the opposite direction of the front, odd-numbered addresses (front east, back west) should receive the sunset design. This incorrect assumption led to counting the wrong set of clients.
